### No. 1: Seedance 2.0: 15-Second Cinematic Japanese Romance Short Film

![中文](https://img.shields.io/badge/lang-中文-red)
![Featured](https://img.shields.io/badge/⭐-Featured-gold)

#### 📖 Description

A highly detailed, 15-second multi-scene prompt for Seedance 2.0, designed to generate a cinematic, ultra-realistic Japanese high school pure love short film.

#### 📝 Prompt

```
15-second cinematic Japanese drama pure love ambiguous short film, ultra-realistic quality, warm golden sunlight in an empty classroom in the afternoon, soft film grain, shallow depth of field, 24fps, gentle handheld camera
0-4 seconds: Extremely slow push-in shot from a medium shot of the desktop to a close-up of the two people's side profiles sitting side-by-side, the tips of their fingers almost touching but never quite meeting, warm backlight outlining their silhouettes, dust motes floating slowly through the golden sunlight
4-9 seconds: Switch to a close-up of the boy. His school uniform collar is slightly loose, his expression restrained yet tender, a faint smile at the corner of his lips, subtle breeze stirring his hair
Lip synchronization is natural and precise, emotional micro-tremors and breathing are synchronized, the background piano and strings swell gently
```

### No. 2: Seedance 2.0: Product Commercial with Native Audio

#### 📖 Description

A studio product shot for a sports drink, with native audio.

#### 📝 Prompt

```
Premium sports drink commercial, high-speed splashing liquid, dynamic camera orbit, crisp condensation droplets on the aluminium can, studio rim lighting, native audio: upbeat electronic beat with liquid splash SFX
```
